PROJECT: matchigo

TYPE:
TypeScript pattern matching library (Rust-like, lazy-compiled, type-safe exhaustiveness)

PURPOSE:
Fast, data-driven and chained pattern matching engine for TypeScript with compile-time exhaustiveness guarantees.
Designed for both human developers and AI agents with explicit performance-oriented semantics.

CORE CONCEPTS:
- matcher(): chained API for expressive pattern matching
- match(): data-driven one-shot matching with caching
- compile(): precompiled reusable matcher function
- matchWalk(): cold-path zero-compilation matcher
- P.*: pattern primitives (guards, refinements, combinators)

SUPPORTED MODES:
- Chained matching (matcher)
- Data-driven matching (match / compile)
- Cold-path direct matching (matchWalk)

PERFORMANCE MODEL:
- Literal-only patterns compile to O(1) Map dispatch
- Complex patterns use optimized tree traversal
- Compilation is cached when possible

FOR AI AGENTS:
- Prefer compile() or hoisted matcher() when possible
- Use matchWalk() only when rules are created per call
- Avoid rebuilding rule arrays inside hot loops
- Respect exhaustiveness constraints strictly

AI_CONTEXT_PRIORITY:
AI.md > README.md > source code
